external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Our partnerships with Firefly Health & Amwell mean help is just a few clicks away.
Our partnerships with Firefly Health & Amwell mean help is just a few clicks away.
National network through Cigna Healthcare PPO National Network

Blue Circle is a partner who works with Members over the age of 18 with Type 1 diabetes. They will coordinate with a Member’s existing care team to provide free virtual endocrinology care, nutrition advice, peer support, counseling, financial assistance, access to insulin and education, including how to use glucose monitoring tools and insulin pumps through phone, text and video calls. You can learn more about this program from our recent news release.

Twig is a partner who works with members with Type 2 diabetes. Twig Health’s licensed nurses will text and call Members, offering help accessing diabetes-related care, including scheduling A1C and blood pressure tests, foot exams, nutrition counseling, eye exams and other need. If you receive a message from (207) 401-6402, this is not spam and is verified outreach.
UST is a partner who encourages Members to schedule primary care visits.
Signify is a partner who schedules and arranges in-home annual wellness visits with Members.
